correctness.summary: Independent brute-force enumeration reproduces 105 underlying classes, 23,352 marked classes, G(q), G(1)=87612, and the first five Bousseau-series coefficients.

limitations: The lambda-series interpretation depends on Bousseau's published correspondence.
Only F0 bidegree (3,4) with the stated marking convention is audited.

originality.summary: Bousseau supplies the general theorem; the contribution is the explicit finite (3,4) census and specialization.

scientific_value.summary: A concrete exact genus-one refined floor-diagram ledger provides a reproducible normalization and implementation check.
